name: Price is multiplied in once
summary: Each $/credit is resolved once per export and pasted into the SQL as a literal; checks never join a price table.

name: Credits, TB and $ kinds are never summed together
summary: cost_lines turns every line into usd before summing; the app keeps one money kind per check and never adds spend, change and waste.

name: Days with no usage count as $0 days
summary: A GENERATOR day spine CROSS JOINed with each product and LEFT JOINed to usage fills missing days with 0 before baselines.

name: One as-of date ends every window
summary: __AS_OF_DATE__ is set once per export (tomorrow with include_today, else now minus 8 h) and is the exclusive end of every window.

name: Cloud services priced after the daily 10% adjustment
summary: Warehouse rows are compute + cloud services x that day's billed ratio from METERING_DAILY_HISTORY; totals use CREDITS_BILLED.

name: Query attribution is not the warehouse bill
summary: Idle = compute - attributed only for hours older than 8 h with a non-NULL split; adaptive or NULL reads NOT_ASSESSED no_query_attribution.

name: A source the role cannot see reads NOT_ASSESSED, never clean
summary: The export probes every view with LIMIT 0 and every SHOW; unreadable checks run their fallback or read role_cannot_see; SQL emits *_not_visible rows.

name: Fail-safe rows with NULL names are not live tables
summary: Live tables need a name, no drop time and no table_entered_failsafe; dropped-table checks label them 'Fail-safe table (id)'.

name: Session, password and authentication policies are not read from POLICY_REFERENCES
summary: Session coverage reads NOT_ASSESSED policy_attachment_not_listed when a policy exists; password and authentication come from SHOW ... ON ACCOUNT.

name: Read BASE_TABLE_ID or TABLE_ID while the rename rolls out
summary: SEARCH_OPTIMIZATION_HISTORY rows are read as OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*) and keyed by COALESCE(o:BASE_TABLE_ID, o:TABLE_ID).

name: Org billing windows end settle_days (3) before as-of
summary: ORGANIZATION_USAGE money checks take :settle_days (default 3) and end the window at as-of minus settle_days for the 72 h lag.
